Custom machine: embroidery area, compatible hoops, transfer methods and limits are unverified. Choose sizes manually.
Connect to a PC with a USB cable and copy PES files to the root of the machine’s Removable Disk. Android phone/OTG recognition is unverified. This is not a USB flash-drive connection.
Copy PES files to a compatible USB flash drive, then insert it into the machine and retrieve the design.
Use a compatible USB flash drive, or Brother’s wireless transfer through Design Database Transfer (Windows), PE-DESIGN 11 or Artspira. Direct wireless transfer from myembro is not implemented.
Confirmed hoops: 100×100 mm; optional 60×20 mm. This app currently offers 100×100 mm projects.
Confirmed hoops: 100×100 mm; optional 60×20 mm and repositionable 100×170 mm. A single design remains limited to 100×100 mm. The app does not automate repositioning.
Temporary USB disk: up to 12 designs, root folder only. Numeric PES stitch limit: unverified.
Numeric design-count and PES stitch limits: unverified.
Internal memory: up to 20 designs / 1024 KB, up to 100,000 stitches per design. USB drive design-count and stitch limits: unverified.
PES filename length limit: unverified. Brother recommends letters A–Z/a–z, digits, hyphen and underscore.
